# `./res/check/bench-arms.janet`; do not edit.

# Each row is a corpus whose `.wattle` arm is compared against what
# `res/repo/janet-to-wattle.janet` produces from its `.janet` arm.  `same`
# means the two are the same program by derivation rather than by assertion.
#
# A difference in a form voids any ratio measured over that corpus.  A
# difference in a comment does not, and the two known ones are path
# references each arm is right about in its own world.
